text:
anya: kicking off marketplace bootstrap for AWS/GCP/Azure — want to align roles, assets, legal checklist, and packaging kit. target: soft launch next Tues. who can own hero/legal/ops?

mike: I can own partner-facing packaging + storefront metadata. need hero image, short description, 1-pager, pricing model.

raj: I'll own product artifact package + trial flow. @sophia can you confirm telemetry/oss disclaimers?

sophia: yea, can do. need image sizes and AMI/container repo access. prefer terraform snippets for infra bits. also will handle runtime docs.

Dave (dave-legal): flag: we need EULA + privacy addendum for EU customers, and KMS notes for Private. I'll review if you drop draft link.

anya: thanks. mike — I'll add you to the publisher portal and give sandbox creds. mike: can you prepare SKU mapping and trial entitlement table?

mike: on it. putting starter sheet here: https://docs.internal/redwood/marketplace/starter-kit (shared). CSV template attached. will map seat vs usage.

raj: quick ops note — for AWS we need AMI id or container uri, for GCP a gcr path, for Azure a managed image id. example snippet:
```
provider "aws" {}
resource "aws_ami" "redwood" { id = "ami-0abc123" }
```
please fill.

sophia: tagging deploy-bot to confirm staging region capacity :rocket:

deploy-bot: Capacity check passed for us-east-1 and europe-west1. note: us-west-2 has low reserved pool for Dedicated — recommend fallback region.

anya: dave-legal — dropping draft EULA here: https://drive.redwood/legal/eula-draft-v1.docx — can you review by EOD Friday?

Dave (dave-legal): will review. also need marketing copy that avoids 'bank-grade' claims. send proposed sentences.

mike: draft short desc: 'Redwood Inference: low-latency LLM inference with predictable billing and private deployment options.' ok to iterate.

anya: fine. action items:
- mike: SKU mapping + CSV by Thu
- raj: artifact identifiers (AMI/GCR/ManagedImage) + terraform snippets by Thu
- sophia: runtime docs + telemetry PR by Fri
- dave-legal: EULA + EU addendum review by Fri
I'll schedule a 30m sync Thu 9am PT. /cc @sophia @mike @dave-legal

raj: ack. adding checklist to the tracker: https://issues.redwood/MP-1234

mike: thanks. will upload hero image (1200x600) and logos to shared drive today.

sophia: FYI some customers require HSM integration note — add key-wrap options to doc.

anya: noted. anyone else? if not, closing thread for now. :thumbsup:
